response.text: The tables were created with quoted uppercase names, so I'll rerun the checks with double quotes.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO" = h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT") <> SUM(l."CR_AMT")

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID" = h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD" = 'C' AND h."POST_DT" > COALESCE(p."CLOSE_DT", p."END_DT")

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p."PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID" = i."INV_ID"),0) AS paid FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD" = 'P' AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p."PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID" = i."INV_ID"),0) <> i."INV_AMT"

SELECT a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID" AS dup_id, a."VEND_CD", a."INV_NO", a."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT" FROM "APINVH" a JOIN "APINVH" b ON b."INV_ID" > a."INV_ID" AND UPPER(TRIM(a."VEND_CD")) = UPPER(TRIM(b."VEND_CD")) AND REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(a."INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') = REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(b."INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g')
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD") = TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT") IS DISTINCT FROM i."INV_AMT" AND SUM(l."CR_AMT") IS DISTINCT FROM i."INV_AMT"
